summary: T. Rowe Price OHA Select Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K to report the pricing of a private placement of $400M aggregate principal amount of 6.500% Notes due 2031 at 98.900% of par. The notes mature July 2, 2031, are redeemable at the fund's option with a make-whole premium before June 2, 2031, and interest pays semi-annually. Proceeds will fund investments, reduce borrowings, and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable; the offering is expected to close July 2, 2026.
